local gui = game:GetService('Players').LocalPlayer.PlayerGui
local root = gui:FindFirstChild('GfxRoot', true)
local ui = gui:FindFirstChild('Ui', true)
local list = {}
for _, r in { root, ui } do
	for _, d in r:GetDescendants() do if d:IsA('GuiObject') then table.insert(list, d) end end
end
local st = {}
local blink, blinkBy = 0, {}
local alphaJump, alphaBy = 0, {}
local frames, t = 0, 0
while t < 6 do
	local dt = RS.RenderStepped:Wait()
	t += dt
	frames += 1
	for _, d in list do
		local s = st[d]
		if not s then s = { v = d.Visible, hid = 0, p = d.AbsolutePosition, a = nil } st[d] = s end
		local v = d.Visible
		if v then
			if not s.v and s.hid >= 1 and s.hid <= 3 and (d.AbsolutePosition - s.p).Magnitude < 14 then
				blink += 1
				local k = (d.Parent and d.Parent.Parent and d.Parent.Parent.Name or '?') .. '.' .. (d.Parent and d.Parent.Name or '?') .. '.' .. d.Name
				blinkBy[k] = (blinkBy[k] or 0) + 1
			end
			s.p = d.AbsolutePosition
			s.hid = 0
			if d:IsA('ImageLabel') then
				local a = d.ImageTransparency
				if s.a and math.abs(a - s.a) > 0.45 then
					alphaJump += 1
					local k = (d.Parent and d.Parent.Name or '?') .. '.' .. d.Name
					alphaBy[k] = (alphaBy[k] or 0) + 1
				end
				s.a = a
			end
		else
			s.hid += 1
		end
		s.v = v
	end
end
local function top(m)
	local o = {}
	for k, c in m do table.insert(o, { c, k }) end
	table.sort(o, function(a, b) return a[1] > b[1] end)
	local l = {}
	for i = 1, math.min(10, #o) do table.insert(l, o[i][1] .. 'x ' .. o[i][2]) end
	return table.concat(l, ' / ')
end
